question: Within a radius of 120 kilometers, where can I locate fast food restaurant on the journey from Miami Beach Urban Studios (FIU MBUS), Miami Beach, FL to Butterfly World, Coconut Creek, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.132523 25.790419)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.17159 26.268652)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.132523 25.790419)',4326)::geography, 120000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.132523 25.790419)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
